name: painterly-chameleon-itch
description: Async one-to-many Painterly Chameleon validation app

scripts.package:itch: VITE_API_ORIGIN=https://pc.lucasacademy.org npm run build:itch && cd dist && zip -FSrq ../painterly-chameleon-itch.zip .
scripts.live:check: node scripts/import-live-painting.mjs content/live-projects/van-gogh-sunflower-parlor-1a.lpp van-gogh-sunflower-parlor-1a --check && node scripts/import-live-painting.mjs content/live-projects/van-gogh-starry-studio-1b.lpp van-gogh-starry-studio-1b --check && node scripts/import-live-painting.mjs content/live-projects/van-gogh-cypress-bedroom-1c.lpp van-gogh-cypress-bedroom-1c --check
scripts.check: node --check src/core.js && node --check src/worker.js && npm run live:check && npm run build && npm test
